name: W&B Weave
description: Track OpenClaw agent sessions in W&B Weave for observability and debugging.

entity.description: W&B team or username slug. Required; the plugin throws on startup if unset.

project.description: W&B project name. Required; the plugin throws on startup if unset.

apiKey.description: W&B API key. String literal (discouraged), or a { source, provider, id } SecretRef resolved through OpenClaw's secret providers (env works out of the box; file/exec require a configured provider). Omit to let the Weave SDK resolve credentials from WANDB_API_KEY or netrc.

serviceName.description: Surfaced in `/weave status` for operator visibility. Not currently stamped onto the OTel resource by the Weave Node SDK; tracked separately.

agentName.description: Override for weave.agent.name. Falls back to harnessId/pluginId from events.

agentVersion.description: weave.agent.version attribute. Leave unset to use the plugin package version, or set an explicit string (e.g. 'v0.1') to pin.

captureContent.description: Conversation content captured into spans. Defaults to true so traces are useful out of the box. Set to false for a hard off (compliance/retention policy). Captured content is NOT redacted by the plugin; operators are expected to scrub upstream if needed.

captureContent.label: Capture conversation content
captureContent.help: On by default; empty traces aren't useful. Set to false when compliance or retention policy requires it. Content is not redacted by the plugin; scrub upstream if needed.
